rules.title: Switch to a green host
rules.why: Hosting on renewable energy directly lowers a page's carbon footprint.

rules.title: Optimise images
rules.why: Large images are usually the biggest source of transfer bytes. Compress and use next-gen formats (AVIF/WebP) and responsive sizes.

rules.title: Reduce JavaScript
rules.why: Heavy JS increases bytes and CPU. Remove unused code, defer non-critical scripts, and question large frameworks.

rules.title: Trim web fonts
rules.why: Subset fonts, limit weights/styles, and prefer system fonts where possible.

rules.title: Cut overall page weight
rules.why: The page exceeds a healthy weight budget. Reducing total transfer is the most direct lever on carbon.

rules.title: Apply top PageSpeed opportunities
rules.why: Lighthouse lists specific, prioritised fixes. Address the highest-savings items first.
